definitions.explanation: Describes someone with a strong, durable physical constitution that resists illness and hardship. Suggests rugged health and resilience.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{頑健|がんけん}で、{風邪|かぜ}ひとつ{引|ひ}かない。
examples.english: My grandmother is robust and never catches a cold.

examples.japanese: {農作業|のうさぎょう}で{鍛|きた}えられた{頑健|がんけん}な{肉体|にくたい}の{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}だ。
examples.english: He has a hardy body built through farm work.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {頑健|がんけん}な{体格|たいかく}.

NUANCE: {頑健|がんけん} emphasizes durable, resilient strength - the ability to withstand hardship and resist illness. It suggests a rugged quality built through physical work or inherited constitution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頑健|がんけん}な{体|からだ}/{肉体|にくたい} (sturdy body)
- {頑健|がんけん}な{体格|たいかく} (robust build)
- {頑健|がんけん}な{人|ひと} (hardy person)

RELATED WORDS:
- {丈夫|じょうぶ} (healthy, strong - more common)
- {屈強|くっきょう} (brawny, sturdy - more muscular)
- {壮健|そうけん} (healthy, robust - more formal)
- {虚弱|きょじゃく} (weak, feeble - opposite)
